1) 5 min: quick TL;DR on product fit for Sunset Therapeutics (pick the three high-impact flows).
2) 12–15 min: live run of a sandbox workflow that demonstrates latency and cost controls (short prompts + batch inference).
3) 7–10 min: embedding + reranking example for search relevance (since you mentioned catalog ingestion last week).
4) 3 min: next steps and recommended configs for a POC.

Logistics: recording will be MP4, 1280x720, plus a short timestamped index file so you can skip to sections. For the live Q&A I'd prefer Fri 11/13 10:00am PT (as Irene suggested) — we can keep that to a strict 30 minutes. If you need an earlier slot, I'm available 8:00am PT.

If you'd like, I can also include a 2–3 minute clip focused solely on the Dedicated deployment checklist for your infra team.
